title: Etale descent of local module flatifications
statement: Let $S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, $f:X\to S$ a morphism of schemes, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $U\subset S$ a quasi-compact open. Suppose a finite family of diagrams $X_i\xrightarrow{j_i}X$, $X_i\to S_i\xrightarrow{e_i}S$ commutes with $f$. Assume each $e_i$ is quasi-compact and etale, $S=\bigcup_i e_i(S_i)$, each $j_i$ is etale, and $X=\bigcup_i j_i(X_i)$. Suppose for each $i$ there is an $e_i^{-1}(U)$-admissible blowup $S_i^*\to S_i$ such that the module strict transform of $j_i^*\mathcal F$ on $X_i\times_{S_i}S_i^*$ is flat over $S_i^*$. Then there is a $U$-admissible blowup $S^b\to S$ such that the module strict transform of $\mathcal F$ is flat over $S^b$. Admissibility and module strict transform have the meanings of [def-nagata-admissible-blowup], [def-trf-module-strict-transform]; etale means smooth of relative dimension zero [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].
